content.text: The NBA season concluded on Sunday with all 30 teams in action and playoff seeding at stake.In the East, the Raptors secured the No. 5 seed and the final unclaimed guaranteed spot in the playoff field with a win over the Nets, relegating the 76ers and Magic to the play-in.AdvertisementIn the West, the Nuggets secured the No. 3 seed with a win over the Spurs, sending the Lakers to the
